title: Deep Learning Applications in Software Engineering
citation: Deep Learning Applications in Software Engineering. International Conference on Software Engineering (ICSE), 2024.
abstract: Deep learning has been applied to various software engineering tasks, such as bug detection, code completion, and code review. This paper provides a comprehensive survey of deep learning applications in software engineering, including a discussion of the challenges and opportunities in this area.
